name: Love Is Respect
description: 24/7 free, confidential support for young people navigating relationships
fullDescription: Love Is Respect, a program of the National Domestic Violence Hotline, supports young people ages 14-24 with questions or concerns about their dating relationships, offering 24/7 phone, text, and online chat with trained advocates.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 phone support
- Text support (text LOVEIS to 22522)
- Online chat
- Advocates trained in dating abuse, healthy relationships, and crisis intervention
- Relationship education, quizzes, and resources
- Safety planning
- Support for loved ones and educators too
howToGetIt:
1. Call: 1-866-331-9474
2. Text LOVEIS to 22522
3. Chat online at loveisrespect.org
4. Advocates available 24/7/365
5. Free and confidential
keywords: Love Is Respect, youth, teens, young adults, ages 14-24, dating abuse, relationship help, text LOVEIS 22522, 1-866-331-9474, online chat, safety planning
